What happens next:
The Postal Service will begin searching for your item. Search requests may take up to 7 business days to be reviewed. You will receive status updates by email. Please do not submit a duplicate request for the same item, as this may delay your search.

To check the status of your request, visit https://www.usps.com/help/missing-mail.htm and sign in with your USPS.com account.

If you have questions, call 1-800-275-8777.
